description: Proposes every dependency update: the GitHub Actions, the images pinned by digest in the workflows and hooks, and the tools the workflows install by version.

customManagers.description: Images run by digest in the workflows and the hooks, written <image>:<version>@sha256:<digest>.
Claude Code, which CI installs from npm by version to validate the plugin and the marketplace.
PyYAML, which CI installs from PyPI by version for the plugin's rule checks.

packageRules.description: Never the runner images in runs-on, while the Actions still move: a new runner image is a pull request of its own.
The Actions, pinned by commit with the version in a comment: minor and patch updates share one pull request.
The images CI and the hooks run: minor, patch and digest updates share one pull request, and majors each get their own.
GHCR gives no release date, so Renovate can't hold its images back 7 days, and without this would never propose them. The pull request says to check the release's age by hand.
prBodyNotes: `{{{depName}}}`'s registry gives no release date, so this pull request didn't wait 7 days: before merging, check on the project's releases that it came out at least 7 days ago.
